reason: The largest number of letters at which the widest group of a one-letter word and the next word from the site's texts fits the narrowest line with the text at 200 %: paragraphs, headings, list items, table headers and cells, data-label, ui-badge and ui-pill-button on a phone 320 pt wide and in the administration's tables 900 and 1000 px wide. Measured by e2e/largest-text.spec.ts ('Given the longest word a one-letter word keeps beside it…'), which fails when this number differs from the measurement: the binding places are the intro heading of /o-nas and an h2 of the privacy policy on a phone 320 pt wide, a 280 px line where 'k zálohám…' (7 letters) needs 285 px, and the card title of /sprava at 320, 900 and 1000 px, a 208 px line (209 px in WebKit) where it needs 211 px (212 px). A no-break space is required up to this length; before a longer word it stays only where the group fits, which the 200 % checks of e2e/accessibility-keyboard.spec.ts guard.
